nodes.name: High-Temperature Liquid Shock (Ir variant)
nodes.procedure: Typically, salts of acetylacetonate with an equal mole ratio, including 8.0 mg of Pt(acac)₂, 5.2 mg of Co(acac)₂, 5.9 mg of Ni(acac)₂·2H₂O, 8.1 mg of Ru(acac)₃, 9.9 mg of Ir(acac)₃ and 10.0 mg of Vulcan XC-72R carbon black were dispersed in a mixture of oleylamine (9.0 mL), oleic acid (1.0 mL), and formaldehyde solution (0.8 mL). Then the mixture was ultrasonicated for around 30 min, followed by magnetic stirring for around 2 h to obtain a homogeneous mixture. Afterward, 2.5 mL of the aforementioned mixture was transferred into a crucible fixed in carbon fiber felt (5.5×4×1 cm), which was connected to two electrodes of a DC power supply (eTOMMENS, eTM-3060C) and maintained for 60 s with the current of 38 A in an Ar atmosphere. The products (referred to as PtCoNiRuIr/C) were collected by centrifugation at 10000 rpm for 6 min and then washed five times with a mixture of n-hexane and ethanol (volume ratio of 1:1) to remove impurities and organics.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM shows lattice fringes of 0.21 nm for fcc (111) facet; GPA confirms uneven lattice strains from atomic radius differences.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 2d provides a partially enlarged image of PtCoNiRuIr/C, revealing lattice fringes with interplanar crystal spacings of 0.21 nm, corresponding to the (111) facet in face-centered cubic (fcc) phase... A geometric phase analysis (GPA) image (Figure 2e)... confirms the existence of uneven lattice strains in HEA-NPs.

properties.description: Crystalline lattice spacing indicated by arrows

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM with EDS mapping shows homogeneous distribution of Pt, Co, Ni, Ru, Ir elements throughout the nanoparticles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) image and the corresponding energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) elemental mapping revealed the homogeneous distribution of Pt, Ni, Co, Ru, and Ir elements in the entire nanoparticle on carbon black.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-MS confirms elemental composition of PtCoNiRuIr HEA-NPs consistent with EDS mapping results.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Moreover, the elemental compositions of the PtCoNiRuIr HEA-NPs, determined by inductively coupled plasma mass spectroscopy (ICP-MS), agreed with the EDS elemental mapping results (Figure S8 and Table S2).

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows weak broadened (111) fcc peak at 42.9° (lattice spacing 0.213 nm vs pure Pt 0.226 nm), indicating 5.7% lattice contraction from multi-element doping.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the slightly enhanced peak observed was the broadened peak at 42.9°, which corresponds to the (111) facet of the fcc phase... According to the PDF standard card #65-2868, the lattice distance of pure Pt (111) is 0.226 nm, whereas the (111) lattice spacing of the as-obtained PtCoNiRuIr HEA-NPs... is 0.213 nm. Compared to pure Pt, the lattice spacing decreased by 5.7%.

nodes.characterization_summary: FFT pattern verifies crystalline fcc phase of PtCoNiRuIr HEA-NPs with diffraction rings for (200) and (111) facets.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The fast Fourier transform (FFT) shown in Figure 2f verifies that the PtCoNiRuIr HEA-NPs are crystalline fcc phases, with two obvious diffraction rings corresponding to (200) and (111) facets.
